newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy to help Albania rebuild its health service.
newsitem.headline: Italy to help Albania rebuild its health service.

text.p: Italy said on Tuesday it had reached an agreement with Albania to help it rebuild its health service.
Italian Health Minister Rosy Bindi signed a deal with her Albanian counterpart Astrit Kalenja after talks in Rome.
"The programme is not just to take care of emergencies but to launch a real reconstruction plan for the Albanian health service," Bindi told a news conference.
Italy aims to collaborate with Albania on health services, including the state of its hospitals, and training.
Bindi said the programme would be carried out at a local level by technical groups working with Albanian specialists.
Albania has been swept by weeks of unrest following the collapse of dubious investment schemes earlier this year. Much of the south remains in rebel hands.
Italy is leading a multi-national security force to protect aid shipments that began deploying in Albania one week ago.
